original_title: Estimating Human Fat and Muscle Conductivity From100Hz to1MHz Using Measurements and Modelling

Equation10.tau_conversion: Table3 microseconds multiplied by1e-6 to seconds

population_conditions.temperature_source: Room and skin-surface temperatures before/after are individual plots in Figure1d; no uniform37C assumption
population_conditions.inference_type: Population probabilistic inverse estimate from noninvasive tetrapolar impedances and subject-specific models, not isolated-tissue direct measurement

orientation.fibre_direction: Laplacian field inferred through the entire segmented forearm muscle volume
orientation.tissue_pooling: Forearm muscles and tendons segmented as one muscle material
orientation.scalar_substitution_warning: Assigning one component to all axes is an explicitly isotropic component-based substitute, not fibre-resolved human muscle.

uncertainty.conditional_95percent_credible_intervals: Frequency-specific, equal-tailed marginal posterior intervals; not universal subject variability or Table3 parameter confidence intervals
uncertainty.fat_tau_alpha_reliability: Weak effect on fit; authors call them unreliable
uncertainty.source_frequency_grid: 46 points from10^1.5Hz to10^6Hz; fits exclude values below100Hz

supplement.name: Conductivity_table.xlsx
supplement.source_contains: Figure7 MAP estimates and95percent credible intervals in table form

explicit_hybrid_option.conductive_real_part: Re(Kangasmaa Equation10), human forearm inverse-model substitute
explicit_hybrid_option.displacement_term: j*omega*epsilon0*Re(Gabriel1996III complex permittivity), mixed-source generic reference
explicit_hybrid_option.do_not_add: Do NOT additionally add Gabriel ionic or dispersive real conductivity; do NOT infer epsilon from Kangasmaa imaginary conductivity
explicit_hybrid_option.classification: Explicit hybrid of human other-site real conductivity and generic mixed-source dielectric reference; not measured human thoracoabdominal complex material

no_new_skin_constants: Paper fixed skin conductivity0.44 as a nuisance assumption, not estimated SC or dermis. Do not adopt as measured layer-specific skin data.
